x: The two sprint races brought to light a very promising young Poly junior named Brant, who ran second in both events and beat some seasoned runners in doing so.

Grieve of the Whitgift scored a fine sprint double with Brant of the Poly second in both races. Quinlan set a rare pace in the 880 Yards only to be beaten down the straight, and he should improve with better racing tactics.

Metcalfe took the furlong in 23.6s., being chased home by Brant, Harris, Molyneux and Vine. Watts scored a double by winning the 440 in 51.1s., with Bishop third, and 880 in 2m. 5.4s., with Brown third and Bishop fourth.
M.P.; 2 Clay (B); 3, Brant (B) 10.4. Second Race: 1, Wiley (B); 2, Broome, 10.6.
